content.short: Earn Network is a liquid marketplace for yield-earning opportunities via staking tokens and NFTs in locked or flexible pools.
content.description: Earn Network is a decentralized yield origination platform launched in 2023 by the team behind MyCointainer. It lets users stake tokens and NFTs and access pools that can be either locked or flexible, aligning with different liquidity preferences. Developers can leverage the platform’s robust infrastructure to implement staking solutions, boost liquidity, and enhance user engagement across supported chains. Safety is a central focus, with audited smart contracts and a secure environment designed to minimize risk for participants and projects.
